intro: Caturday double-header! Our guy worked both rooms today: a bear interrogation (and a self-bump!) on the Stocktwits SPY board, plus a Microsoft engineers post, a genius Amazon delivery reform plan, and a peak-fitness cat on X.

items.caption: Caturday wouldn't be complete without a cat check-in, and our guy delivers: a clip he's crowning "peak feline physical condition." Chonky cat appreciation is always in season!
items.quote: This is peak feline physical condition

items.caption: Policy proposal of the year: Amazon should deliver in order of how many times you've clicked "track order." Refresh-button warriors everywhere, your champion has arrived!
items.quote: Amazon deliveries should be delivered in order based on how many times the person has click “track order”

items.caption: Two words and a picture: "Microsoft engineers." After this week's outage saga, our guy is still keeping tabs on the folks in Redmond. The running bit lives on!
Saturday morning on the SPY and TSLA boards, and our guy asks the question every bull has wondered: "Why are bears like this?" Picture attached, case closed.
And when the bears didn't answer, he reshared his own question with a one-word follow-up: "bump." Persistence is a virtue!
